units.source_text: 岛村把视线移开，看了看地藏菩萨。

en.t: Shimamura looked away and glanced at the Jizo Bodhisattva.

units.source_text: 地藏菩萨有三面长脸，除了放在胸前合十的双手以外，左右还各有两只手。

en.t: The Jizo Bodhisattva had three long faces, and besides the two hands pressed together before its chest, it had two more hands on each side.
